newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Foreign inflows into Brazil bolsas down in May - CVM.
newsitem.headline: Foreign inflows into Brazil bolsas down in May - CVM.

text.p: Net foreign capital inflows into Brazilian stock exchanges under Annex Four rules totalled $510.02 million in May, down from $601.79 million in the previous month, Brazil's Securities and Exchange Commission (CVM) said.
Foreign buys were $2.337 billion, while foreign sales totalled $1.827 billion, it said in a statement.
In the first five months of 1997, net foreign investment amounted to $3.409 billion, nearly all of last year's total foreign investment which reached $3.593 billion.
Annex Four regulates foreign investment in Brazilian stocks, debentures and privatization bonds.
